summary: Syberia entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Syberia
entries.definitive_edition: Syberia Remastered for normal play; original Windows PC release for historical comparison

emulation.notes: Use native remaster for primary; original PC route only for historical comparison.

primary.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S
primary.why: Syberia received a modern remaster in 2025 with rebuilt visuals and reworked navigation/puzzles, making it the current fidelity route for a normal archive playthrough. The 2002 original remains the historical route for exact point-and-click presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use Syberia Remastered on PC or current-generation console. Record platform/build, control mode, puzzle/navigation changes, graphics settings, and whether the 2002 original was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for historical comparison if the remaster changes puzzle flow or interface behavior.
secondary.why: The remaster modernizes the game and should not be treated as identical to the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether playing remaster or original, because puzzle/interface changes can affect preservation notes.

entries.title: Syberia II

primary.why: Syberia II is a direct adventure sequel and the PC version is the best capture route for the Benoit Sokal point-and-click experience. Console/mobile ports are access routes, but PC keeps the most straightforward pointer/input and compatibility documentation path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam or GOG PC release. Record storefront/build, compatibility fixes, resolution/window mode, language/subtitles, save state, and whether console/mobile versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a specific port.
secondary.why: PC is the cleaner archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront/build, compatibility state, language, and save continuity from Syberia if relevant.
